Current _start_server kills its subprocess tree on address collisions and every other BaseException, retries ports, and uses a 180-second readiness deadline. Porting the older narrow patch would overwrite broader stabilization.
The current test still used a scheduler-racy one-second timeout. The port gives the child five seconds to publish its PID and asserts elapsed time proves the timeout path performed the reap.
The file handler still preempted lifespan basicConfig, leaving application records in backend.log only. The port establishes the console sink first and adds a dual-sink regression test.
The root loading boundary still wrapped async layouts and could remain dehydrated in hidden tabs. Only the root fallback was removed; eight route-level loading boundaries remain for soft navigation.

Main replayed the first two slices in the opposite order and has a patch-identical hardening commit. Current workspace is intentionally the only writer; porting the old branch would revive the removed rollout/legacy dual-writer path.
